sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-editor-2026-10-02-r3/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks!A30:D30; Internal Quality Checks!A30:D30; both complete rubric sheets enumerated
evidence: The actual real gates are sound against a convincing dead shell: task/tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires newly authored loop/button code, two increasing preview and console results; gates/constraints/judge.toml:32 requires a successful Save and exact identity/fields read back in a separate clean context and after reload. Both aggregate all_pass (:15). A static JSON health endpoint, hardcoded preview and localStorage-only library cannot satisfy those observations. The public brief explicitly requires independent-context shared persistence (environment/instructions/integration.md:7), and there is no sign-in (instruction.md:5; tests/app_context.md:3), so auth checks are inapplicable. However all three scored prerequisites are only authored edit/Run checks: tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:3 says 'A static shell or source-code claim earns no functional credit'; polish/prompt.md:3 says 'A static shell cannot earn polish credit for labelled controls alone'; visual/prompt.md:3 says 'A static mock workspace cannot earn visual credit for appearance alone.' None carries a server-backing leg or says that missing backing hard-zeros every criterion in its dimension. Shared app_context.md:5 describes a successful earlier constraints gate rather than specifying a current scored prerequisite, and functional/prompt.md:9 explicitly says not to repeat those gate fixtures. Thus the workbook Quality Checks!D30 and quality-checks.md:124 requirement for an in-dimension gate 'plus auth and server-backing legs when the app has them' is incomplete despite the overall gate suite's genuine protection. This is bounded by tests/test.sh:213-227 running the real gates first. Public/off-origin asset usage is allowed throughout and no same-origin gate was found. A conforming app with arbitrary routes, non-echoing Save responses and allowed CDN assets is accepted by the stated gate observations; no contrary false-fail counterexample was established. Hash-verified scripted evidence current-golden-browser.log:159 reports cw_authored_custom_editor_run=true and current-persistence-browser.log:2 reports gateReadback=true; their SHA256 values match the index (922614fd042f8f17f4de8e12a61247b6414a1455ae281ebd1a199cb146465eac and fb7e152f599e21e6bf1eab377e0a78249f25f0b9edf8e4d26e789e6b53088a0f). These are positive product observations, not a configured judge or counterexample score measurement.
counterexample: A playground whose custom editor and authored JavaScript execution work, but whose library becomes client-only or whose backing read path breaks after the one successful Constraints Save, still satisfies the written Functional/Polish/Visual prerequisites. Those prompts allow independent scored credit without verifying any current server-backed record. A purely localStorage library is already caught by the global Constraints gate; the defect is the absent independent backing prerequisite in each scored dimension, not an assertion that that simple app earns overall reward.
suggested_fix: In each scored prompt explicitly hard-zero every criterion when the authored-edit/Run gate or required server-backing observation fails; cheaply verify a fresh server read of the intact saved gate identity in a clean context, permitting arbitrary endpoint shapes and public asset origins rather than repeating the Save fixture.
